description: Probe the endpoint of one of your external functions now: one sample call, recorded with the history and fed into the router's circuit breaker. Pass function_id. It calls your endpoint, so a function that is not active and external with an endpoint URL is refused. Read the history with get_function_health. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

name: run_function_health_probe
